mesh_read_ply — FILEIO mesh op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_read_ply(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.mesh_read_ply(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("mesh_read_ply"))

Usage

Read ASCII or binary PLY and return a table of vertices, faces, colors, normals, and scalar attributes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

未知の頂点スカラーは attributes に保つ。未知の要素、面の未知プロパティ、未知の list property は名前を示して拒否する。呼び出し例: table = mesh_read_ply(ply_bytes)。
